sources.title: Doppler radar
sources.explanation: Reflectivity, ZDR column and KDP core observations provide the storm structure.

sources.title: INSAT
sources.explanation: Cloud-top cooling provides an independent satellite view of convective growth.

sources.title: Lightning network
sources.explanation: Observed flashes anchor active-storm density and first-lightning timing.

sources.title: NWP
sources.explanation: CAPE, shear and freezing level describe the storm environment.

stages.title: Quality control and time alignment
stages.explanation: Observations are checked and aligned to the same analysis time before fusion.

stages.title: Common grid with missing-sensor and data-age masks
stages.explanation: A shared grid preserves data-age and unavailable-sensor uncertainty for every cell.

stages.title: Temperature-coordinate electrification features
stages.explanation: Features at the 0, −10 and −20 °C levels capture electrification structure.

stages.title: Multimodal temporal transformer with neural advection
stages.explanation: Temporal fusion carries storm structure forward while neural advection estimates movement.

stages.title: First-lightning survival head and Active-storm density head
stages.explanation: Separate heads estimate time to first flash and the density of an active storm.

stages.title: Conformal calibration and uncertainty
stages.explanation: Calibrated uncertainty widens the forecast region when the evidence is less complete.

stages.title: Risk corridors, evidence and alerts
stages.explanation: Calibrated forecasts become operational corridors, meteorological evidence and warnings.
stages.feature: Risk corridors, evidence and alert composer
